name: Gnosis
title: Gnosis
text:
A Gnosis, plural Gnoses, is an item resembling a chess piece which embodies the Heavenly Principles' control over Teyvat and its "laws." Seven Gnoses were created, implied to each have been given to the original members of The Seven following the Archon War.
## Overview
Following the war of funerary flame, the Heavenly Principles defeated Nibelung but was severely injured in the process, leaving them unable to use their absolute authority to subdue the world's original order. To compensate, the Heavenly Principles and "one who came after" created the Gnoses from the remains of the Third Descender, Saarelainen, as part of a "new order." The gods were driven to fight each other over possession of the Gnoses, with seven victors ultimately being chosen to each possess one of the elemental Gnoses. were unaware, while the Tsaritsa and Zhongli are implied to know more than they let on. It appears that Archons may retain a proprioceptive connection to a Gnosis even after giving it away, as Mavuika sensed the Pyro Gnosis' disappearance before Nahida confirmed it.
It is suggested that Visions began appearing either around the same time as the Gnoses or after The Seven were established, Just as Visions cannot be destroyed or tampered with via mundane human methods, Ei failed in her attempts to modify her Gnosis into an energy supply device.
Skirk learned of the macabre history behind the creation of the Gnoses from her master Surtalogi, and consequently considers them to be "object[s] of 'misfortune'" which can bring disaster upon their owners, warning Neuvillette that "once a person dies, the bonds he once had with this world shall all turn to curses." described as more advanced in comparison to a Vision. Additionally, the Gnoses serve a crucial function in assisting the Heavenly Principles' in maintaining their control over Teyvat, though the concrete details of how they do this is unknown. They are said to represent the Heavenly Principles' laws
Unlike humans, who are usually dependent upon a Vision to use elemental energy, Archons can use elemental abilities independently of a Gnosis and do not become powerless without it. while Nahida comes in possession of both the Electro and Pyro Gnoses at different points in time but is only ever described as the Dendro Archon. later on, she also uses the Pyro Gnosis to burn down Irminsul. Similarly, while Scaramouche never demonstrated any elemental abilities beforehand, he was able to manipulate lightning and the weather while connected to the Electro Gnosis; with Ei's own attempts at connecting him to the Gnosis ending in failure. Both Neuvillette and the Traveler have briefly demonstrated the ability to use a Gnosis, and Arlecchino, despite being a human, believed she could use the powers of the Hydro Gnosis to save Fontaine from the prophecy, though the opportunity to do so never came to pass.
## Uses in Infrastructure
Various Archons have used or plan to use their Gnoses for the betterment of their nations, typically as a power source for a device critical to the nation's current social and/or political infrastructure.
The Golden House in Liyue, managed by the Liyue Qixing, minted Mora for the entirety of Teyvat since the Geo Archon's power was needed to create Mora. Ever since Zhongli's surrender of the Geo Gnosis and Rex Lapis' alleged demise, the Golden House has remained shut down. The project never came to fruition due to the intervention of Traveler and Nahida's allies,
The Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale in Fontaine, which generates a form of energy known as Indemnitium through trials conducted at the Opera Epiclese, was secretly merged with Focalors — the actual Hydro Archon, not Furina as publicly believed — and powered by the Hydro Gnosis. Only a small amount of Indemnitium was actually used to power the Court of Fontaine; the majority was accumulated so Focalors could execute herself and destroy the Hydro Archon's throne when the time was right. Following her demise, the Oratrice ceased to function. The Sacred Flame in Natlan was kept alive using the Pyro Gnosis during the Abyss' attack against Natlan. After the events of Nod-Krai, Nahida uses the Pyro Gnosis she received from from Mavuika (who considered it a permanent transfer, though Nahida intended to return it if possible) borrowed via the Traveler to burn down the corrupted Irminsul after seeing the damage wrought by Dottore's machinations.
* Various promotional videos about Snezhnaya had the players use Gnoses as actual pieces on the board.
** In A Winter Night's Lazzo, the Anemo Gnosis is likely used as a king, as the board would then match a position from  between  and , and if the Anemo Gnosis were used as a queen in that game instead, the resulting position would be unusual. The Geo Gnosis appears to be used as a rook in the same game.
*** As there are two king pieces in the center of the board where the queens would be in the real world, the Anemo Gnosis might instead be the queen, with the positions of the queens and kings for each side being swapped relative to the real match. The strange positions of the kings would be explained by Pierro's statement that this version of chess does not end when checkmate happens.
** In Sudden Snow, the Cryo Gnosis is possibly used as a king as well, as the board would match another position from a real chess game between  and . In this comparison, the Geo Gnosis would once again be used as a rook, while the other Gnoses, playing for black, had been captured by white earlier on.
*** The only black pieces which are unaccounted for are a queen, a knight, a bishop, and a pawn. It is likely that the Anemo, Electro, Dendro, and Hydro Gnoses match these pieces, though it is unknown which piece matches which exactly. The Anemo Gnosis could plausibly have been used as a queen, as it may have been in the first game.
*** In the real chess game, it was Black's turn to move, but in the teaser, it was White (the Tsaritsa) to move. Under standard chess rules, the move would be illegal, though the king may not be subject to the same rules in a game where checkmate does not conclude the game.
***  Alternatively, as in the first game, as the white king is visible to the side of the board, the Cryo Gnosis may once again be the queen, with the positions of king and queen pieces being swapped relative to the real game.
*** Including Gnoses and pieces that have been taken, the number of pieces in the game totals 33, one more than is legal under normal chess rules.
* The top/crown of the Hydro Gnosis resembles an inverted , a stylized lily design used most commonly by and associated with .
* It is currently uncertain how much the mortal people of Teyvat know about Gnoses. Venti states that his Gnosis "isn't something [he is] meant to discuss with ordinary people," while many of the rank-and-file members of the Fatui do not seem to know much about the Harbinger's operations on the Tsaritsa's behalf.
** Yae Miko is aware of the power of a Gnosis and its connection to Celestia, and was responsible for guarding the Electro Archon's Gnosis. Whether this is information known to the kitsune youkai or simply because Raiden Ei briefed her on its function beforehand remains to be determined.
** Beidou seems to have at least a basic understanding that the Gnoses belong to the Archons when the Traveler mentions their thefts during her Hangout Event, When the Crux Shines Bright. How much she knows about their power and nature beyond this is currently unknown.
** Though not explicitly mentioned, the sages involved in the god creation plan likely knew about the Electro Gnosis due to its importance to their plan.
** Lyney and Lynette knew of Arlecchino's plan to use the Hydro Gnosis to break the prophecy before handing it over to the Tsaritsa. who are among the small group of people she has been working with to save Natlan.
** Before Ayizu died, he told Thrain (known later as the Fatui Harbinger "The Captain") about the secret of the Pyro Gnosis, which caused him to resent Mavuika for not fulfilling her oath and prolonging the inevitable. Ayizu also repeatedly urged Mavuika, the Pyro Archon at that time, to use the Pyro Gnosis to defeat the Abyssal force, which she refused each time for her own reasons.
## Etymology
* In ,  is a term used for wisdom, knowledge, or insight into divine nature. Through Gnosis, one can transcend the material realms controlled by the seven archons and enter the supercelestial realm of .
* The Chinese term for Gnosis,  is similar to the term for . Both of them are called  which was translated as "magical foci" in English.
** During Teyvat Chapter Interlude Teaser: A Winter Night's Lazzo, after Capitano inquires about Scaramouche and the Electro Gnosis, Il Dottore replies that "Divine Knowledge cannot be rationally comprehended." The Chinese equivalent for "Divine Knowledge" is , where  is the Chinese term for the Gnostic concept of gnosis.
